name: keyword-extract
description: RAKE (Rapid Automatic Keyword Extraction, Rose et al. 2010) keyword-phrase extraction from English text. Splits text into candidate phrases at stopwords and punctuation, scores each word by (co-occurrence degree + frequency) / frequency, and scores each phrase as the sum of its words' scores. Returns ranked keyword phrases and ranked individual words. Use this to pull out the salient multi-word terms from a document or query without an LLM call.

text.description: The text to extract keywords from.

top.description: Maximum number of ranked phrases/words to return. Defaults to 50; hard-capped at 500 regardless of what is requested.

language.description: Stopword list to use. Only "en" is supported. Defaults to "en".

keywords.description: Candidate keyword phrases, ranked by RAKE score descending.

words.description: Individual content words, ranked by (degree+frequency)/frequency descending.

truncated.description: true if the full candidate set was longer than the returned keywords/words lists (i.e. the top-N or 500-entry hard cap cut something).
